content.text:
Read-only parity audit complete.

| Area | Web capability and source | Mobile status | Recommendation | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Session gesture | Full chat/session system. | Tutor already has a left-edge right swipe to Sessions: `PanResponder` requires start ≤32px and ≥72px horizontal drag in [index.tsx](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:57), attached at [98](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:98). It is one-way, undiscoverable, and does not swipe between all tab surfaces. | Keep this as a shortcut, add a small first-use hint, but rely on reachable tabs rather than gesture-only navigation. | P2 |
| Bottom navigation | Web nav reaches Pricing, Courses, Live, Tutorial and more. [Nav.tsx](web/src/components/Nav.tsx:96) | Exactly four tabs: Tutor, Sessions, Library, Settings in [_layout.tsx](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:40). No Courses, Live, Wallet, Tutorial, or manual entry. | Make bottom navigation five items: Learn, Sessions, Courses, Library, More. `More` holds Settings, Wallet, Tutorial and Manual. This keeps primary learning content reachable without making a 7-item tab bar. | P0 |
| Sessions | Persistent multi-session chat. | Native local sessions are real and searchable, plus create/delete. | Native is appropriate and already mostly aligned. | P3 |
| Basic composer | Rich web composer: model action, attachments, speech/live, cancel/send, thinking level. [AssistantChatPanel.tsx](web/src/components/AssistantChatPanel.tsx:4735) | Native is text-only, multiline, 12k max, send/stop, retry, and provider gate in [index.tsx](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:191). Streaming itself is real. | Native next: attachment picker for image, PDF and text with visible removal/error states; a model/thinking sheet; preserve draft on provider failure. | P0 |
| Composer tools/artifacts | Browser agent exposes animate, deck, course tools, image generation, quiz, policy, etc. [browser-tools.ts](web/src/keating/browser-tools.ts:54) | Mobile has inline quiz/question/goal cards, but no tool loop. The project explicitly says scene, image, animation and flashcard cards are not ported in [README.md](mobile/README.md:49). | Do not expose controls for unavailable tools. Native-port the highest-value response cards (deck, image/scene preview) only when their execution/rendering exists; otherwise offer a clearly labelled “Continue on web” action for that response. | P1 |
| Live voice, camera, screen | `/live` has model choice, key recovery, voice, camera and screen toggles in [Live.tsx](web/src/pages/Live.tsx:101). Composer can launch the same portal overlay in [AssistantChatPanel.tsx](web/src/components/AssistantChatPanel.tsx:889). | No native Live route, media controls, speech settings, or audio/video capture. | This needs a native implementation before claiming feature parity: Expo audio/video capture, permissions, capability-tier UI, duplex provider transport, transcript preservation, camera fallback. A `Live on web` link is acceptable as an explicitly separate handoff only, since browser keys/session are not the Android client’s keys/session. | P0 |
| Courses | Durable hosted/local course library, joins, workspace, realtime and collaboration: [Courses.tsx](web/src/pages/Courses.tsx:429), [CourseWorkspace.tsx](web/src/pages/CourseWorkspace.tsx:296). | No route, client, auth/session adapter, API surface, course storage, or realtime connection. | Add the Courses bottom tab immediately as a truthful “Open Courses on Keating Web” handoff, labelled as such. Native course reading, authoring and realtime collaboration is a separate substantial build, not a tab-only task. | P0 |
| Hosted wallet / token purchase | Pricing invokes the Not Organic access dialog and credit packs in [Pricing.tsx](web/src/pages/Pricing.tsx:43); it loads account/wallet and opens provider checkout in [NotOrganicAccessPromptDialog.tsx](web/src/components/NotOrganicAccessPromptDialog.tsx:121). Provider settings also show a hosted balance in [CloudProviderKeysSection.tsx](web/src/components/settings/CloudProviderKeysSection.tsx:135). | Native provider catalog is BYOK only: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter, Custom in [provider-config.ts](mobile/src/lib/provider-config.ts:12). No Not Organic provider, account, wallet, checkout, or auth boundary. | Add Wallet in More as a web handoff to `/pricing`, opening the system browser, not a fake in-app balance or checkout. It must say “Web checkout” and not promise token use in native chat until native hosted authentication and provider routing exist. | P0 |
| Provider/model discovery | Web supports cloud/OAuth providers, provider visibility, custom providers, model discovery and custom models. [ModelsProvidersTab.tsx](web/src/components/settings/ModelsProvidersTab.tsx:11), [MyModelsSection.tsx](web/src/components/settings/MyModelsSection.tsx:129). | Native exposes a fixed provider list plus editable model ID/base URL in [settings.tsx](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:93). | Native: add provider model discovery only for endpoints that support it, then capability-tag models. Keep custom entry. Do not present arbitrary model IDs as verified/available. | P1 |
| Provider keys/account | Web uses browser-local keys plus OAuth/hosted sign-in. | Native direct-provider keys in Android Keystore is real, and correctly stated. | Preserve this as an intentional native privacy advantage. Hosted account is not a substitute for direct BYOK and must be implemented separately. | P2 |
| Learning/speech settings | Web has Learning, Speech/Voice, persona and learner-profile configuration. [LearningTab.tsx](web/src/components/settings/LearningTab.tsx:26), [SpeechSettingsTab.tsx](web/src/components/SpeechSettingsTab.tsx:374). | Native has persona and temperature, but no learner profile, voice/TTS, mic, live provider, video source, speech queue, or custom voice configuration. [settings.tsx](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:170) | Native speech/live settings should land with the actual Live capability, not as inert settings. Learner profile can be ported independently. | P1 |
| Interface/privacy/diagnostics settings | Web has font/profile, reasoning visibility/level, raw errors, image/animation, sharing, analytics and privacy-masked replay. [KeatingUiSettingsTab.tsx](web/src/components/KeatingUiSettingsTab.tsx:181), [537](web/src/components/KeatingUiSettingsTab.tsx:537). | Native settings stop at provider, key, persona, temperature and clear local data. [settings.tsx](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:220) | Add native-relevant controls: appearance/theme, diagnostics/raw provider error disclosure, export/delete, telemetry consent, then reasoning controls when provider support is tracked. Do not copy browser-only replay or image settings without native backing. | P1 |
| Local data/sync | Web includes broader storage/collaboration surfaces. | Native accurately states it is local-only, with no desktop P2P sync. [README.md](mobile/README.md:53) | Keep disclosure. A “Sync” setting must be disabled/labelled unavailable until a real relay/native peer design exists. | P2 |
| Tutorial/manual | Web has a routed Tutorial and nav link, [App.tsx](web/src/App.tsx:172), [Nav.tsx](web/src/components/Nav.tsx:146). There is no separate web `/manual` route found. | No mobile tutorial, manual, docs, or support links. | Add “Tutorial” and “Manual & support” under More. Start with native setup/onboarding for this client, then open the canonical web tutorial/docs externally for full material. Do not label a non-existent web route as “Manual.” | P0 |
| Library | Web offers broader tool-generated artifacts. | Native Library can generate deterministic plans/maps/quizzes offline and manage saved notes, [artifacts.tsx](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/artifacts.tsx:54). | Keep native. It is a legitimate focused subset, but should not be described as the full web artifact surface. | P2 |

Bottom line: the app is a solid local-BYOK tutoring client, but it is not feature-parity mobile yet. The immediate product fix is navigation honesty and reachability: expose Courses, Wallet, Tutorial, and Manual/support from the bottom navigation/More; make web-only destinations explicit handoffs. The parity-critical engineering work is the composer feature set, native Live, hosted account/wallet integration, and course client.

content.text:
Review result: safe to install for Pixel validation, with two acceptance issues to check/fix before calling it complete.

- [P1] The Live handoff is truthful about native Live being absent, but [live.tsx](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/live.tsx:40) opens web Live while [line 41](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/live.tsx:41) sends users to native provider settings. Android BYOK keys and conversations do not carry into the browser. Also, the copy names voice/camera but omits web screen sharing. Clarify that web Live starts separately and needs web-side setup; mention screen is provider/model-dependent.

- [P1] The requested swipe is implemented at [index.tsx](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:57) and mounted at [98](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:98), but its `x0 <= 32` zone conflicts with Android’s left-edge Back gesture. The current test only string-checks it ([mobile-design-foundation.test.ts](mobile/test/mobile-design-foundation.test.ts:74)); validate on a gesture-navigation Pixel before acceptance.

Everything else matches the requested information architecture:

- Mascot/bot Tutor icon and five bottom destinations are present in [_layout.tsx](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:40).
- Model selector is correctly in the Tutor header, before the composer, with a 44dp control and label in [index.tsx](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:102).
- Courses clearly discloses web handoff and missing native sync in [courses.tsx](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/courses.tsx:29).
- Tokens/credits, Tutorial, and a valid Manual link are reachable under More in [more.tsx](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/more.tsx:20); link failure has a recoverable address alert in [open-product-link.ts](mobile/src/lib/open-product-link.ts:3).
- The test coverage verifies route presence and canonical destinations, but not rendered width, actual links, or Pixel gestures ([mobile-design-foundation.test.ts](mobile/test/mobile-design-foundation.test.ts:83)).

Minor a11y polish: set the repeated mascot images on Courses/Live decorative (`accessible={false}`), since their adjacent headings provide the meaning.
I’ll trace the model catalog and selection state end to end, then compare the Tutor/Sessions controls to propose a native-safe parity slice without assuming browser-only storage or APIs.

content.text:
1. Catalog sourcing

Web does not fetch `models.dev` at runtime. It reads Pi AI’s generated static catalog through `getModels()` in [provider-models.ts](web/src/lib/provider-models.ts:459), then adds custom-provider discovery. The selector supplies search, provider/capability filters, recents, stale-request protection, error fallback and refresh UI in [ModelSelector.tsx](web/src/components/ModelSelector.tsx:101).

Safest mobile approach:

- Generate a small shared JSON manifest at build time from the same Pi AI catalog, preserving provider, model ID/name, API, text/image/reasoning capability, context/max output and catalog revision.
- Ship that manifest with the app and cache the last successfully validated refresh in AsyncStorage. Refresh only an app-supported subset through a Keating endpoint, not direct `models.dev`.
- Filter selectable models to the five native transports in [types.ts](mobile/src/lib/types.ts:1): OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter, Custom. A whole web catalog would advertise providers which [provider-client.ts](mobile/src/lib/provider-client.ts:53) cannot call.
- Match web behavior: search name/ID/provider, provider and capability chips, up-to-seven recents, refresh, and “show cached built-ins” error fallback. Discover custom endpoint models only when the user explicitly refreshes that endpoint.
- Do not import web `compat` into Metro. It is the full generated catalog surface and mobile needs a deliberate subset.

2. Atomic selection state

Current mobile APIs allow half-updates:

- `setProvider()` replaces settings with defaults at [KeatingProvider.tsx](mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:426).
- `updateProviderSettings()` independently patches provider/model/base URL at [430](mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:430).

Add one context method, e.g. `selectProviderModel(selection)`, accepting:

```ts
{ provider: ProviderId; model: string; baseUrl: string; catalogKey: string }
```

It should do exactly one functional `setState`, updating provider, model and resolved base URL together. For a provider change, start from `settingsForProvider(provider)`, then override model/base URL. Preserve temperature intentionally. Add the recent key only after this commit. Disable selection while generating, rather than cancelling a response, because completion snapshots global settings at [192](mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:192).

The model picker must never retain OpenAI’s base URL while changing to Google, nor select an arbitrary Custom catalog model without the associated endpoint.

3. Session-control issues

- Tutor renders the active session title at [index.tsx](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:116) beside a `New lesson` button at [118](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:118). A fresh session is itself titled “New lesson” in [types.ts](mobile/src/lib/types.ts:63), producing duplicate adjacent text. Hide that default title, use “Untitled lesson”, or make the header button icon-plus-accessible-label.
- Sessions has a whole-row Open action at [sessions.tsx](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/sessions.tsx:62), then nests Delete inside it at [81](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/sessions.tsx:81). This is an accessibility and interaction hazard: nested Pressables, invisible “Open” affordance, and reliance on propagation stopping.
- `OPEN` at [76](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/sessions.tsx:76) is state, not an Open button, which further muddles the vocabulary.

Use a non-interactive row container, a full-width explicit “Open lesson” Pressable, and a sibling overflow/Delete action. Keep deletion confirmed.

4. Forking recommendation

Add `forkSession(sourceSessionId, throughMessageId)` to the provider. Expose “Fork from here” in a message action sheet, disabled while streaming. On selection:

1. Validate source/message and take the transcript through that message.
2. Create a new session, make it active, route to Tutor, and label it `Branch · <source title>`.
3. Clone every copied message with new IDs and retain `sourceMessageId` metadata for lineage.
4. Persist `forkedFrom: { sessionId, messageId }` on the new session. This requires a versioned state migration because storage currently accepts only schema v1 in [storage.ts](mobile/src/lib/storage.ts:9).
5. Do not duplicate saved artifacts automatically; they remain attached to the source. Forked card answers can be reattempted.

New message IDs are mandatory: feedback currently matches IDs across all sessions ([KeatingProvider.tsx](mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:355)), and artifact saving finds the first session containing an ID ([377](mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:377)). Reusing IDs would cross-update the source and fork.
I’ll trace the new catalog and fork flows through storage, provider transport, and UI actions, then report only concrete blockers or risks. Read-only.

content.text:
- **P1 — Forking during a live response cancels the original and snapshots an incomplete transcript.** `forkSession` calls `stopGeneration()` and immediately clones `stateRef`; the stream’s final buffered content is applied only afterward. Earlier message actions and whole-session forks remain available while generating. Disable fork while generating and do not abort an unrelated response. [`KeatingProvider.tsx:339`](mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:339), [`index.tsx:165`](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:165), [`sessions.tsx:99`](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/sessions.tsx:99)

- **P1 — Corrupt or malformed persisted state is silently replaced with a fresh state.** Migration casts any versioned JSON object without validating it; `normalizeState` dereferences `candidate.sessions.length`. Hydration catches that failure, marks itself complete, then the save effect persists the empty initial state 120ms later. Parse safely, validate/quarantine invalid state, and only enable persistence after a successful migration. [`storage.ts:13`](mobile/src/lib/storage.ts:13), [`KeatingProvider.tsx:102`](mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:102), [`KeatingProvider.tsx:174`](mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:174)

- **P2 — The models.dev refresh can remain permanently stuck with no usable retry.** The fetch has neither timeout nor cancellation; while it remains pending, `refreshing` stays true and disables Refresh. Closing the sheet only suppresses state application, not the request. Add an abortable timeout and cancel on close/unmount. [`model-catalog-storage.ts:33`](mobile/src/lib/model-catalog-storage.ts:33), [`ModelSelectorSheet.tsx:70`](mobile/src/components/ModelSelectorSheet.tsx:70), [`ModelSelectorSheet.tsx:236`](mobile/src/components/ModelSelectorSheet.tsx:236)

- **P2 — The picker claims transport compatibility but validates only text output and context size.** Any matching catalog model becomes selectable, then is sent through hardcoded Anthropic, Gemini, or OpenAI Chat Completions streaming protocols. There is no endpoint/streaming compatibility qualification, so a catalog entry can be accepted but fail only after the learner sends a prompt. Gate entries through an explicit per-transport compatibility map or a server-provided curated catalog. [`model-catalog.ts:53`](mobile/src/lib/model-catalog.ts:53), [`model-catalog.ts:79`](mobile/src/lib/model-catalog.ts:79), [`provider-client.ts:58`](mobile/src/lib/provider-client.ts:58), [`provider-client.ts:79`](mobile/src/lib/provider-client.ts:79), [`provider-client.ts:110`](mobile/src/lib/provider-client.ts:110)
I’ll verify each remediation end to end, including its tests and any introduced state or recovery regressions.

Re-review result:

- **Fork blocking/no cancellation: partially closed.** The destructive `stopGeneration()` call is gone, the context guard rejects forks while `isGenerating`, and both fork controls are disabled. [`KeatingProvider.tsx:341`](mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:341), [`MessageBubble.tsx:69`](mobile/src/components/MessageBubble.tsx:69), [`sessions.tsx:99`](mobile/src/app/(tabs)/sessions.tsx:99)  
  Residual P2 race: `isGenerating` is only set after awaiting SecureStore, so an existing “Fork here” action can still be used during that pre-stream window. The fork no longer cancels anything, but can snapshot before the just-sent user turn reaches state. Set a generation-starting lock before the key await. [`KeatingProvider.tsx:198`](mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:198), [`KeatingProvider.tsx:204`](mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:204), [`KeatingProvider.tsx:212`](mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:212)

- **Persisted-state validation/quarantine/persistenceReady: closed.** The new validator rejects malformed envelopes before normalization, invalid JSON/state reaches the error path without setting `persistenceReady`, and persistence is gated accordingly. Existing storage is preserved rather than overwritten. [`persisted-state.ts:76`](mobile/src/lib/persisted-state.ts:76), [`storage.ts:12`](mobile/src/lib/storage.ts:12), [`KeatingProvider.tsx:155`](mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:155), [`KeatingProvider.tsx:176`](mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:176)  
  No data-loss regression found. Minor recovery limitation: a SecureStore/persona read failure shares the same `Promise.all` catch and therefore also prevents session hydration and future writes, despite valid AsyncStorage. [`KeatingProvider.tsx:150`](mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:150)

- **Refresh timeout and abort: closed.** Refresh now has a 30-second abortable timeout, cancels on a new refresh and when the sheet closes/unmounts, and retains cached/built-in results on error. [`model-catalog-storage.ts:33`](mobile/src/lib/model-catalog-storage.ts:33), [`ModelSelectorSheet.tsx:71`](mobile/src/components/ModelSelectorSheet.tsx:71), [`ModelSelectorSheet.tsx:91`](mobile/src/components/ModelSelectorSheet.tsx:91)  
  No regression found in control flow. There is no automated timeout/abort test yet.

- **Transport compatibility patterns/tests: partially closed.** The new per-provider deny patterns and unit cases filter several known non-chat models. [`model-catalog.ts:39`](mobile/src/lib/model-catalog.ts:39), [`model-catalog.test.ts:72`](mobile/test/model-catalog.test.ts:72)  
  It remains a name-based blacklist, not a positive compatibility contract for the hardcoded chat/SSE protocols. A newly named Responses-only or non-streaming text model will still be presented as callable and fail only at send time. The original transport-truth issue is therefore reduced but not fully closed. [`model-catalog.ts:62`](mobile/src/lib/model-catalog.ts:62), [`provider-client.ts:58`](mobile/src/lib/provider-client.ts:58), [`provider-client.ts:110`](mobile/src/lib/provider-client.ts:110)
